system.description:
FOLKWARDEN MENTAL SOUL UTILITY
Folkwarden Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (material, verbal)
Area 15-foot emanation
Duration 1 minute

You scatter salt, herbs, ash, seeds or fragments of protective material while speaking one of the short wards traditionally used when there is no time to prepare a proper threshold.
You and willing creatures within the area gain a +1-status bonus to saving throws against:
Curse effects;
Fear;
effects with the Mental trait;
possession; and
effects with the Soul trait.
A creature loses the benefit while outside the emanation and regains it if it returns.
Hedgeward can function within a Ward the Threshold, but bonuses of the same type do not stack normally.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the emanation by 10 feet.
+2 PP: Increase the status bonus by 1, to a maximum of +3.
+4 PP: Increase the duration to 10 minutes.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
